Dear Sir, 
 
Re: 
Disclosure under Reg. 30 read with Sch. III. Part A. Para A of SEBI (LODR) 
Regulations, 2015 – Participation in Institutional Investors’ Meeting 
 
We wish to inform you that today, Mr. Rajiv C. Lochan, Managing Director, participated in an 
institutional investors’ meeting hosted by Ashika Stock Services Limited, Mumbai, through video 
conferencing, for various institutional investors, as set out vide Annexure, regarding the trends 
and news in the sector, and the Company. It was a group meet from 12.30 P.M. to 1.30 P.M. 
 
We hereby confirm that: 
 
1. The interactions were in the Q&A format.  
2. No presentation was made by the KMP.  
3. No Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) was shared during the interaction.  
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours truly, 
For Sundaram Finance Limited 
 
 
 
P.N. Srikant 
CCO & Company Secretary
